what_v2_did_not_show: Candidate intelligence has no predictive value.
Candidate intelligence adds no value over F0.
A locally conditioned or party-heterogeneous candidate layer cannot help seat probabilities.
An LLM reasoner cannot add value when supplied with a correctly specified transition representation.
corrected_interpretation.what_v2_did_show: Under its asymmetric baseline and universal-coefficient specification, retained same-party same-district incumbency did not improve pooled 2021 vote-share RMSE.

corrective_actions: Run a symmetric same-family diagnostic on both transitions using prior-cycle vote as the baseline.
Remove observed party-level national swing and score only territorial redistribution.
Compare a mean-reversion structural model against a candidate-augmented model.
Represent retained incumbency as a transition indicator and interact it with prior local strength.
Allow ridge-shrunk party heterogeneity rather than hand-set party weights.
Do not claim incremental value over F0 until a symmetric historical F0/pseudo-F0 exists.
Do not invoke Opus or modify F0 from this retrospective diagnostic.

material_caveats.consequence: V2 does not identify the incremental value of candidate intelligence over F0.
material_caveats.finding: The 2011→2016 fit used raw 2011 vote shares as its baseline, while the 2016→2021 validation used B*/F0-like structural predictions. A coefficient learned as a correction to lagged vote was therefore tested as a correction to a different model.

material_caveats.consequence: The pooled PJD/RNI cancellation is not a clean test of local candidate information.
material_caveats.finding: The candidate layer was evaluated on absolute party vote-share error even though PJD and RNI underwent very different national swings. A local candidate layer should redistribute a party's national strength territorially, not estimate the national level itself.

material_caveats.consequence: The estimand mixes persistence, mean reversion, nomination selection and any true candidate effect.
material_caveats.finding: Retained incumbency was treated as an unconditional additive level effect although prior local vote already embeds the performance of the incumbent and local machine.

material_caveats.consequence: A candidate coefficient can proxy for regression to the mean or seat-selection strategy.
material_caveats.finding: The V2 candidate coefficient was not tested incrementally against a symmetric local mean-reversion baseline based on prior territorial strength.

material_caveats.consequence: Pooling can erase a real heterogeneous effect or manufacture a misleading average.
material_caveats.finding: One universal incumbency coefficient was imposed on PJD and RNI, despite heterogeneous party organization and a validation result with opposite signs by party.

material_caveats.consequence: Uncertainty was not aligned with the clustering structure.
material_caveats.finding: The prior bootstrap sampled party-territory cells independently although observations share territories, regions and political shocks.

material_caveats.consequence: PASS_MULTIPART_HEAD_POWER must be read as a data-support gate only.
material_caveats.finding: The ≥30 positive and ≥120 known-cell gates demonstrated support and coverage, not ex-ante statistical power or temporal transportability.

material_caveats.consequence: No seat-level value claim, positive or negative, is identified by V2.
material_caveats.finding: Pooled vote-share RMSE was treated as the decisive election metric. Candidate information may matter primarily near constituency rank and last-seat cutoffs.

material_caveats.consequence: A clean historical incremental-over-F0 test remains unavailable without 2007 reconstruction or another pre-registered pseudo-F0 design.
material_caveats.finding: The archive contains canonical 2011, 2016 and 2021 results but no 2007 cycle; the same multi-cycle structural baseline used for 2021 cannot currently be reproduced for 2016.

material_caveats.consequence: Only 2026 can serve as the next prospective falsifiable test.
material_caveats.finding: 2021 is already opened and all V3 work is retrospective exploratory development.

scope: Methodological audit of the candidate-intelligence V2 experiment after the terminal certificate, preserving all original artifacts and numerical results.
